summary_en: NSSK-EPSILON1 launched a tender offer for all common shares of Broadmedia at 2,500 yen per share, with a minimum purchase target of 4,718,100 shares representing 67.47% ownership post-acquisition. The offer period runs from October 30 to December 14, 2026 (30 business days), with the board recommending shareholders to tender, aimed at making Broadmedia a wholly-owned subsidiary and delisting it from the Standard Market.
title_en: Notice of Opinion Endorsement and Recommendation to Tender in Connection with Tender Offer for Our Company's Shares by NSSK-EPSILON1 Inc.
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, Broadmedia Corporation's board of directors endorsed and recommended shareholders to tender their shares in a tender offer initiated by NSSK-EPSILON1 Inc. The bidder, a wholly-owned subsidiary of NSSK-EPSILON2 Inc. (which is owned by NSSK Group-managed investment funds), is offering 2,500 yen per share for all outstanding common shares.

The tender offer will run for 30 business days from October 30 through December 14, 2026. The minimum purchase target is 4,718,100 shares, which would result in the bidder holding 67.47% of voting rights post-acquisition, calculated using the 69,931 total voting rights disclosed in Broadmedia's most recent securities report as of March 31, 2026. The bidder currently holds no shares or potential securities in Broadmedia.

The stated purpose is to make Broadmedia a wholly-owned subsidiary through the tender offer and subsequent procedures, resulting in delisting from the Standard Market. The board's recommendation was approved by all independent directors and audit committee members without conflicts of interest.
